By firm type, though respondents at 
strategy consulting firms saw the highest 
average total cash compensation, 
and most often reported total cash 
compensation of more than $1 million, 
respondents at management and 
advisory firms saw the largest increase 
in total cash compensation from our 
last survey; 49% reported total cash 
compensation of more than $1 million 
in our 2024 survey, an 8 percentage-
point increase from the 2022 survey.
